title: DealerFee
description: One mandatory, non-government charge or dealer-required add-on, expressed in whole US dollars. Examples include a documentation fee or a required pre-installed protection product. When used with Vehicle.price, the amount is already included in that authoritative price. When supplied without Vehicle.price, it is informational and MUST NOT be used to derive a payable price. Do not include sales tax, title, registration, other government charges, or optional products. Fee names SHOULD be specific enough for a buyer to understand what the charge represents and MUST be unique within one fees array.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the mandatory charge or dealer-required add-on.

amount.description: Amount in whole US dollars. When Vehicle.price is present, this amount is already included and MUST NOT be added again. Without Vehicle.price, the amount is informational only.
